thread:
Anya: Quick design review — the dashboard latency charts feel noisy when you have host-level spikes. Thoughts on legend/axis/unit treatment?
Mike: Agreed. Legend takes up too much vertical space when p50/p90/p99 are stacked. Feels heavy on narrow panels.
Anya: Could we use inline shorthand: `p50 • p90 • p99` and make each item hoverable for a full label + example? Keeps layout compact.
Devon: Slight worry: shorthand might confuse non-technical PMs. Maybe show full on hover and a11y text always. @Anya
Tia: Accessibility nit: the outage highlight color is currently failing contrast for 12px labels (contrast ~3.8:1). We should push it darker to hit 4.5:1 or increase label size.
Sarah: Smoothing flag — current default is moving average window=5 which hides short bursts. Can we add a small toggle: 'Smooth: Off / Gentle / Preserve peaks'?
Mike: Frontend already supports `smoothing=ma5|ema|none` in the query. Adding a 'preserve peaks' mode could map to `ema` with alpha tuned. Implementation note for infra.
Devon: For Y-axis units, propose SI compacting (e.g., `1.2M`) with full value on hover tooltip. Also align units across row of widgets when 'align y-axis' is enabled.
Tia: Accessibility: ensure aria-labels include the unit, e.g. 'Latency, median, 120 milliseconds' for screen readers.
Anya: Outlier handling idea: render host-level outliers as thin dotted lines and cluster aggregates as bold solid lines so they remain legible on the same chart.
Sarah: UX copy tweak: rename 'Normalize Y-axis' -> 'Align Y-axis across widgets' (more explicit). Also change 'Smoothing' tooltip to 'Reduces noise; may hide short spikes'.
Mike: Small dev detail: axis formatter snippet we can reuse:
```
const pretty = (v) => v >= 1e6 ? `${(v/1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : v >= 1e3 ? `${(v/1e3).toFixed(1)}k` : `${v}`;
```
Provide full value in hover.
Devon: +1 on dotted host lines. Also suggest a legend mini-key for dotted vs solid so it's discoverable.
Anya: I'll update the Figma frame with compact legend, darker outage color, smoothing toggle states, and dotted host lines. Posting link in a bit. Thanks! :sparkles:
DesignBot: Reminder — design review sync tomorrow 10:30am in #design.
Mike: Ack.
Tia: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
